steps.en: Clone the repo and install the research checkout with a benchmark extra
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，随基准数据装好研究版

steps.en: Fill optimizer + target model keys into .env
steps.zh: 在 .env 里填好优化器与目标模型的 key

steps.en: Materialize the split, then start training the skill doc
steps.zh: 先生成数据切分，再启动 skill 文档训练

steps.en: Each epoch: rollouts -> reflect -> aggregate -> select -> update, accepted only through a validation gate
steps.zh: 每步 rollout→反思→聚合→筛选→更新，编辑过验证门控才接受

steps.en: Evaluate the accepted skill on an unseen split
steps.zh: 在未参与训练的留出切分上评估入选 skill

steps.en: Deploy as one plain Markdown file read by the unchanged agent
steps.zh: 部署为一份纯 Markdown，交给未改动的 agent 读取

value.en: A skill doc that measurably improved under held-out scores — no weight changes, zero extra inference at deploy
value.zh: 一份在留出分数上被实测改进的 skill 文档——不动权重，部署时零额外推理
